header.sources: DGT press release 'Balance siniestralidad septiembre 2026' (Ministerio del Interior), 2 Oct 2026; press reports for rail (see rows).
header.definitions: Road: DGT provisional count of people killed within 24 h of the crash, interurban roads only (DGT standard method; the release text itself does not restate it). Rail: deaths in the named accidents as reported; excludes level crossings, people hit by trains and any other 2026 rail deaths not yet published.
header.as_of_note: Road runs to 30 Sep 2026 (latest official monthly release); rail to 28 Oct 2026. Periods differ.
header.comparability: Not like for like: Eurostat 30-day all-roads figures are higher than DGT 24 h interurban counts, and rail here is two accidents, not a census.
header.licence: DGT notes de prensa are public administration material (reuse with attribution); press figures are cited, not copied. Not verified against a formal licence text.
header.caveats: No 2019 DGT figure found. Urda toll provisional. Official Adif/CIAF/Interior rail 2026 statistics not found.
